segments.text: Do you walk your dog every day?
segments.englishExplanation: Asking how frequently the other person takes their dog out for a walk.
Confirming that they walk the dog very regularly and frequently.
Explaining that the dog really enjoys visiting the park.

segments.text: My cat sleeps all the time. Ha ha!
segments.englishExplanation: Contrasting with a laugh that their own pet cat spends almost all day sleeping.
segments.turkishExplanation: Benim kedimse hep uyuyor. Ha ha!

segments.text: Maybe it is about time for her to play.
segments.englishExplanation: Suggesting that it is finally the right moment for the cat to wake up and play.
segments.turkishExplanation: Belki de artık oyun oynama vakti gelmiştir.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to convey that the proper moment for something to happen has arrived, often implying it could have happened sooner.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir eylemin vaktinin geldiğini veya geciktiğini belirtmek için 'artık zamanı geldi' anlamında kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: It is about time we started dinner.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Artık akşam yemeğine başlama vaktimiz geldi.

quiz.question: In segment 5, what does the speaker mean by saying "Maybe it is about time for her to play"?

options.text: The cat should start being active and play.
The cat has already played for too long.
The cat prefers going out to the park.
The cat needs to take another long nap.
